title: Lowe’s launches 20-minute drone delivery with Wing and DoorDash
source_used: Robotics & Automation News (fulltext, carries Lowe's announcement)
key_facts: Lowe's launched a drone delivery pilot with Wing and DoorDash, delivering select items 'in as fast as 20 minutes'.
The pilot is live at the Lowe's store in Matthews, North Carolina.
It builds on Wing and DoorDash's existing drone delivery in the Charlotte area.
Eligible items include hand tools, paint, soap, tape, all-purpose cleaner and batteries.
Seemantini Godbole, Lowe's chief information and AI officer, says it addresses a project pain point.
No delivery volumes or rollout plan are given.
quote_evidence: Lowe’s has launched drone delivery, the newest fulfillment method for the retailer that delivers select home improvement items directly to DIY and pro customers “in as fast as 20 minutes”.

This pilot is now live at Lowe’s store in Matthews, North Carolina, and adds to same-day fulfillment options for customers, including buy online, pick up in store; curbside pickup and same-day delivery.
The launch builds on Wing and DoorDash’s existing drone delivery operations in the Charlotte area, adding Lowe’s to the growing list of brands now available for delivery via drone.
why_it_matters_hint: A big US retailer is testing drones for everyday home-improvement deliveries.
notes: Company announcement relayed by a trade outlet; one-store pilot.
